a: Dr Joe E. Church (1899–1989) yali musawo omuminsani Omungereza owa CMS mu ddwaliro ly’e Gahini mu Rwanda, era ennaku ze ebbiri ez’okusoma Bayibuli n’okusaba ne Simeon Nsibambi, omuntu wa bulijjo Omunnayuganda, ku Lusozi Namirembe mu Ssebutemba 1929 zijjukirwa ng’akasasi akaakoleeza Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba. Yaweereza mu Afirika okusukka emyaka amakumi asatu era bulijjo yakakasanga nti Okuzuukuka kwali mulimu gwa Katonda, so si gugwe — teyali mutandisi mu ngeri okwegomba gye kutegeeramu ekigambo ekyo, wabula musawo eyali aweddemu essuubi eyali asitudde Bayibuli eggule.

John Edward Church — bonna baamuyitanga Joe — yazaalibwa nga 10 Agusito 1899, mutabani w’omusumba Omungereza ow’omu kyalo. Yaweereza mu Tank Corps mu Ssematalo Ogusooka, ng’afuuliddwa omukungu w’amaggye ku myaka kkumi n’omwenda, oluvannyuma n’agenda mu Emmanuel College, Cambridge, ku nsimbi ez’amaggye okusoma obusawo, gye yayingirira mu Cambridge Inter-Collegiate Christian Union era gye yamanyira olunaku lwennyini olw’okukyuka kwe: nga 29 Agusito 1920. Yatendekebwa mu St Bartholomew’s Hospital, n’atuuka ku ddaala lya MD mu 1926, era mu 1927 n’asaabala okugenda e Afirika ne Ruanda Mission ey’ekibiina kya Church Missionary Society, n’atumibwa e Gahini mu Rwanda.

q: Kiki ekyabaawo ku Lusozi Namirembe mu Ssebutemba 1929?
a: Emyaka ebiri nga gikyali mu mulimu gwe, Church yali akooye nnyo era ng’aweddemu essuubi, n’agenda e Kampala okuwummulako akaseera katono, n’asula ku Lusozi Namirembe. Eyo n’asisinkana omuntu wa bulijjo Omunnayuganda, Simeon Nsibambi, eyali tamatidde si na nsi wabula na ye yennyini n’ekkanisa ye, eyamubuuza ekibuuzo ekizze kiddiŋŋana okuva olwo: "Waliwo ekintu ekimbulamu nze n’ekkanisa ya Uganda. Oyinza okumbuulira kye kiri?" Abasajja bombi baamala ennaku bbiri nga bali wamu nga tebalina kirala kye bakola okuggyako okusoma Bayibuli n’okusaba.

q: Abasajja bombi baakola ki ddala mu nnaku ezo ebbiri?
a: Church teyalina nteekateeka gy’amuwa — wabula enjigiriza ya Keswick ku butukuvu gye yali anywedde ng’akyali muyizi, okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’ekyo ababuulizi baayo kye baayita Obulamu obw’Obuwanguzi, ne Bayibuli eggule. Baayita mu nnyiriri ezikwataganyizibwa (chain-references) n’ebinnyonnyola bya Scofield ebikwata ku kujjuzibwa Omwoyo, nga bagoberera ensonga eyo okuva mu kitundu ekimu okudda mu kirala, era ne basaba; Nsibambi, ng’omutima gumulumiriza okutuuka ku magumba, n’asaba okuleka ekibi kyonna mu kukkiriza. Tewali n’omu ku bo yamanya nti baali bakoleeza kintu — baalowooza nti baali basabira muntu omu yekka.

Yaddayo e Gahini ng’akyuse, n’awandiikira ab’eka sentensi eyafuuka obunnabbi bw’ebyo byonna ebyaddirira: "Kaakano tewali kiyinza kuziyiza kufukibwa kwa mazima okwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu mu Rwanda, okuggyako obutatukuzibwa bwaffe ffennyini." Oluvannyuma yajjukira okusisinkana okwo n’essanyu eryeyoleka ddala — ku ssanyu eringi ery’okubuulira Nsibambi ku kujjuzibwa Omwoyo ne ku Bulamu obw’Obuwanguzi.

q: Omulimu gwe e Gahini gwali gwa ngeri ki?
a: Omutima gw’obulamu bwe gwali eddwaliro e Gahini, era eyo, so si ku kituuti kyonna ekinene, Okuzuukuka we kutera okugambibwa nti kwasibuka bwe kwabalukawo nga mu 1933. Mu 1930 yawasa Decima Tracey — Decie — naye yennyini musawo eyatendekebwa eyakolanga ku mabbali ge, era baakuliza abaana bataano eyo. Okuzuukuka okuva ku ntandikwa kwali kintu kya mulimu gwa bulijjo: abasawo babiri, waadi ejjudde abalwadde, n’okuzuula mpola nti enjiri gye baabuulira yali erina okusooka okuba ey’amazima mu bo bennyini.

Yajja okuyita mu mukozi w’eddwaliro ayitibwa Yosiya Kinuka, omusiba w’ebiwundu ow’amalala eyawakananga mu lwatu obubaka obw’okwenenya, era eyanyiiganga nnyo okuyitibwa wa kibuguumirize. Awo omutima ne gumulumiriza: yayatula mu lwatu eddiini ye ey’erinnya obulinnya n’amalala ge ag’omwoyo, n’akyuka, n’afuuka munne wa Church gwe yakola naye obulamu bwe bwonna. Enkola eyo — omusajja ow’amalala ng’amenyese, ng’atuuma mu ddoboozi eddene ekibi kye kyennyini, mu maaso g’abalala — ye yafuuka yingini y’Okuzuukuka, eyatambulira si ku bwogezi obulungi wabula ku kwatula, okuliyirira n’okutabagana.

q: Yalowooza nti Okuzuukuka kye yatuukako ye?
a: Nedda — ye yandisoose okugamba nti tewali na kimu ku bino kye yakola. Yali aleese Bayibuli ya Scofield, enjigiriza ya Keswick entono, n’okwagala okumenyebwa wamu n’Abafirika be yali azze okuweereza; ebirala byava walala. Yakkiriza nti okuddibwamu okw’amazima okw’okusaba okwa 1929 tekwali kyamagero kimu kye yali asobola okulagako, wabula kintu kyennyini — omuliro e Gahini, obulamu obwakyuka obw’omusiba w’ebiwundu ow’amalala mu ddwaliro, n’abantu emitwalo n’emitwalo abaali bagenda okutuuma ebibi byabwe ne basanga nga binaaziddwa.

Bulijjo yawandiikanga ng’omujulirwa okusinga ng’omuwandiisi w’ebitabo: obulamu bwa Blasio Kigozi, "Awake! An African Calling" (1937); "Forgive Them" (1966), olugero lw’omujulizi Omufirika Yona Kanamuzeyi; era, ng’akaddiye, ebyafaayo bye ye ku kibiina kyonna, "Quest for the Highest" (1981), ebyaggibwa mu bitabo bye yawandiikangamu okumala ekitundu ky’ekyasa. Era yawandiika akatabo "A Great Lover of Jesus" ku William Nagenda.

q: Ekiseera kye mu Afirika kyaggwa kitya?
a: Tekyali kyangu. Mu 1961 yava mu Rwanda wakati mu ffujjo ery’ebika n’ery’ebyobufuzi eryali liyuzaayuza ensi, n’ayambako okuweereza eddwaliro e Kabarole mu Uganda, n’awummula nga mu 1964; yava ddala mu Afirika yonna mu 1972, mu myaka gya Amin, n’asenga e Little Shelford okumpi ne Cambridge, gye yafiira nga 29 Ssebutemba 1989, ng’aweza emyaka kyenda. Yaleka eddwaliro, ebitabo ebitono eby’obwetoowaze, n’ekibiina ekitaatuumibwa linnya lye kubanga teyakikkiriza — obukakafu nti ebintu ebinene ebya Katonda bisobola okutandika nga bitono nnyo era nga biri wansi nnyo.
